description: Recover task state from this host-owned plugin package.

hooks.command: if [ -n "${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then python3 "$ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/task-state-with-files/scripts/lifecycle_hook.py" --host zcode; else python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?}/skills/task-state-with-files/scripts/lifecycle_hook.py" --host claude; fi
